import limited_client as robot
import numpy as np
for j in (0,2,3,4,5,6):
    obs=robot.observe(camera=2); r=obs['robot']
    q=np.array(r['joint_positions'],dtype=float); p=np.array(r['tcp_position'],dtype=float)
    target=q.copy(); target[j]+=0.06
    result=robot.step(target.tolist()+[0.04,0.04])
    aft=robot.observe(camera=2)['robot']
    q2=np.array(aft['joint_positions']); p2=np.array(aft['tcp_position'])
    print('PROBE',j,'result',result,'dq',round(float(q2[j]-q[j]),5),'dp',np.round(p2-p,5),'q',np.round(q2,4),'tcp',np.round(p2,4))
    if result.get('ended') or not result.get('active'): break
print('FINAL_STATUS',robot.status())
PY
